source.source_version: USDA FSA Beginning Farmers and Ranchers Loans page retrieved 2026-10-29; publisher revision date not stated.

mappings.statement: Has not operated a farm or ranch for more than 10 years.
The applicant must not own a farm or ranch greater than 30 percent of the county average farm size, using the most current Census of Agriculture at application time.
mappings.unresolved_reason: The profile lacks the applicant's owned acreage, the applicable county selection rule, the current county average-farm-size value, and the cited Census snapshot/version.

mappings.statement: The applicant must substantially participate in the operation.
mappings.unresolved_reason: The profile and evaluator do not yet encode the source-defined substantial-participation test.

mappings.statement: The applicant must meet the eligibility requirements of the specific Farm Operating Loan, Farm Ownership Loan, or Microloan being requested.
mappings.unresolved_reason: Loan-specific repayment, credit, collateral, borrower, and application requirements require separate source-backed mappings and cannot be inferred from beginning-farmer classification.

unmapped_source_scope: County acreage threshold and its county-selection and census-version rules
Loan-specific repayment, credit, collateral, and applicant requirements
Down-payment loan requirement for beginning-farmer classification and its lender-financing sequence
Current funding availability, application timing, and local office review
evaluation_boundary: Review-only partial mapping. Evaluate only the cited 10-year beginning-farmer classification against a compatible synthetic years_farming fact. Keep all other requirements unresolved; do not present this as overall FSA loan eligibility, approval, or funding availability.
